_meta.description: A photo editor for iPhone and iPad that matches the look of any photo you admire and hands it back as real adjustments. Curves, colour mixer, masks, retouching, culling — on device, non-destructive, inside Photos. $14.99 once.
_title: Luma Editor — Match a Look. Keep Every Slider.

here-luma-was-shown.7c8f3e: Here Luma was shown a vivid Milky Way photograph and a flat, muddy night shot, and asked to make the second look like the first. Nothing below was retouched by hand.
honest-by-design-luma.73db4e: Honest by design. Luma only ever uses what is in the frame. Taking a whole object out means inventing what was behind it — that is a job for Ari Helper, one tap away.

it-handles-the-part.c0bb06: It handles the part of a burst nobody enjoys. Luma groups the near-duplicates, measures each frame for focus, face capture quality and clipping, and suggests which one to keep — then files the picks into a Luma Keepers album, best first, so you can find them in Photos afterwards. Every pick is a suggestion you can change, and nothing is ever deleted.
light-color-detail-effects.2fe46e: Light, Color, Detail, Effects. Exposure, Brilliance, Highlights, Shadows, Contrast, Black and White Point, Vibrance, Warmth, Tint, Sharpness, Definition, Noise Reduction, Vignette and Grain.
luma-measures-how-the.16c5cd: Luma measures how the photo you picked actually looks — its tonal distribution, its colour balance, how it treats each family of hues, what it does in the shadows and the highlights — and then solves for the adjustments that move your photo there. The answer comes back as sliders, curves and a colour mixer you can go on editing, not as a finished picture.
luma-never-invents-anything.a328ce: Luma never invents anything that was not in the photograph. When you need something gone — a leash, a stranger, a sign — Luma hands the picture to Ari Helper's Photo Studio and takes it back with your grade intact.
luma-rebuilds-a-spot.a656ad: Luma rebuilds a spot from the texture already around it — assembled from many samples, so a repair follows an edge instead of stamping over it. Switch to Clone to choose the source yourself.
luma-works-the-other.fb2ac2: Luma works the other way round. Point it at a photograph you admire — your own, or one by a photographer you are learning from — and it studies how that picture treats light and colour, then solves for the sliders that bring your photo there. What you get back is the recipe. Warm it further, pull the highlights down, lift only the blues. It is your edit from the first tap.
luts-lookup-tables-are.f85b9f: LUTs (Lookup Tables) are colour grading presets that other apps can read. Luma generates a real 3D LUT (.cube) from your edit by running an identity lattice through its own renderer, so what you export matches what is on screen — ready for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. You can also export as Camera Raw XMP for Lightroom. Neither format can carry masks or retouching, and Luma tells you when an export is leaving something behind.
masks-linear-and-radial.37c247: Masks. Linear and radial gradients you drag on the photo, luminance and colour ranges, and Subject, Background and People found on device — each with its own full set of adjustments.
match-a-look-keep.1134b2: Match a Look. Keep Every Slider.
match-a-whole-shoot.fec975: Match a whole shoot, or just the subject.
most-photo-apps-sell.e335c5: Most photo apps sell you a look and stop there. You tap a filter, you get a picture, and the only thing left to decide is how much of it you want.
no-luma-edits-non.7d9ff4: No. Luma edits non-destructively through the Photos library: your original file is never touched, Revert to Original always works, edits sync through iCloud Photos, and reopening a photo in Luma restores every slider exactly where you left it rather than starting again from the rendered result.
non-destructive-the-original.ae6e53: Non-destructive. The original is never touched, Revert to Original always works, and edits sync through iCloud Photos.
one-purchase-in-the.1c115f: One purchase in the US, for iPhone and iPad. Prices vary by country.
one-purchase-no-subscription.db859c: One purchase. No subscription, no account, nothing uploaded.
page-through-any-group.8e1a24: Page through any group full size and overrule it. Picks are filed into a Luma Keepers album, best first, and sent straight to the editor. Nothing is ever deleted.
plus-tone-curves-an.cc2bb4: plus tone curves, an eight-band colour mixer and split toning
presets-copy-and-paste.54f1a1: Presets, copy and paste. Keep a look as a named preset or paste one photo's edit onto the next. Framing stays with the photo it was drawn on.
raw-developed-properly-raw.58095d: RAW, developed properly. RAW captures are developed from sensor data, with the full highlight headroom the file carries.
region-against-region-match.ab471b: Region against region. Match a style inside a mask, so your subject takes on their subject's look and the background is left alone.
remove-something-in-ari.6bcb4e: Remove Something in Ari. Luma sends the untouched photo, at full size, to Ari's Photo Studio.
retouch-in-luma-open.e9c393: Retouch in Luma. Open the Retouch tab on the photo you are grading.
save-to-luma-editor.354891: Save to Luma Editor. You land back where you were, with the object gone and every slider still set.
show-luma-a-photograph.2c2dd0: Show Luma a photograph whose look you love. It works out how to get yours there — and hands you the answer as real adjustments, not a filter.
stored-as-a-parameter.b0cd8a: Stored as a parameter. Every spot can be moved, resized or removed long after, like any other slider.
style-matching-presets-and.8d5fa7: Style matching, presets and bulk developing
take-it-elsewhere-export.7c66bc: Take it elsewhere. Export an edit as Camera Raw settings for Lightroom, or as a real 3D LUT for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.
tap-a-blemish-and.6e8340: Tap a blemish and it goes. Luma finds clean skin or sky nearby to replace it with, and you can drag the source somewhere else if you disagree. Spots are stored as adjustments rather than painted into the picture, so a repair can be moved, resized or removed months later like any other slider.
tap-a-blemish-move.3edcf2: Tap a blemish. Move the repair next month.
that-is-the-point.42317c: That is the point of it. Every match lands as ordinary adjustments — Light, Color, Detail, Effects, tone curves, the colour mixer, split toning — and you can change any of them, add masks, crop, retouch, and undo step by step. The Intensity control scales the adjustments themselves rather than fading a finished picture over your original, so the sliders stay meaningful at any setting.
the-developing-room-every.3a8018: The developing room. Every edit is a parameter you can read back and reverse — true to the photograph you took.
the-editor-speaks-the.2e3ef6: The editor speaks the vocabulary of the Photos app and goes further. Every change is a parameter, so a photo reopened next year comes back with every slider exactly where you left it.
the-full-editor-masks.a4f0d7: The full editor, masks, crop and lens correction
the-look-you-want.643dfb: The look you wantA night sky someone else got right

when-both-apps-are.c7b315: When both apps are installed, Luma's Retouch tab offers Remove Something in Ari. Luma sends the untouched photo to Ari's Photo Studio, you remove what you need with Ari's on-device models, and Save to Luma Editor brings you back with the object gone and your grade still applied. Luma itself never invents content; that part happens in Ari, where it is visible.
where-the-subject-sits.0ec498: Where the subject sits in the frame, weighed alongside everything else.
yes-and-inside-it.11f9fe: Yes, and inside it. Luma adds itself to the Photos editing screen — tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma — so the whole editor, your saved styles and your presets are available on a photo or video without leaving Photos.
yes-develop-a-whole.a0c3a0: Yes. Develop a whole shoot at once and Luma matches each photo to the closest style, so the results are consistent without one preset being forced onto pictures it does not suit. Save a look as a named preset, or copy a look from one photo and paste it onto the next.
yes-from-the-photos.40ae4a: Yes, from the Photos editing screen. Open a clip, tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma, and the framing, tone, colour, curves, colour mixer and gradient and range masks all apply to every frame. Content-aware masks are left out of motion — a segmentation recomputed per frame visibly crawls, and approximating it would look worse than not offering it.
yes-luma-editor-is.3b1eca: Yes. Luma Editor is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
